companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text: Meridian Freight is a digital freight forwarder connecting shippers in South Asia and the Gulf with ocean and air carriers. Our platform quotes, books and tracks around 18,000 shipments a year for 900 customers.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Our Graduate Software Engineer programme is a 12-month placement on one of our product teams, with a structured curriculum, a dedicated mentor and a permanent role at the end.

  • Build features in our TypeScript and Node.js booking platform and its React front end.
  • Work with PostgreSQL and integrate with carrier APIs and EDI messages.
  • Write automated tests and take part in sprint planning and code review.
  • Rotate through the Tracking and Quotes teams during the year.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, completed between 2023 and 2026.
  • Project or internship experience with JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Basic SQL.
  • Fluent English.

Nice to have: React, Docker, or any exposure to logistics.

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text: Hybrid in Lahore or Dubai, or fully remote within Pakistan. Salary PKR 220,000-280,000 per month (Lahore) or AED 9,000-11,000 per month (Dubai). Medical cover for you and your family, and a laptop of your choice.
